name: Dense and Sparse Hybrid Retrieval
mechanism: Runs dense semantic and lexical or learned-sparse retrieval independently, then fuses ranked candidates before reranking.
use_when: Both paraphrases and exact identifiers appear
Per-lane scores or ranks can be logged and evaluated
avoid_when: One lane consistently adds only duplicates
Latency budget cannot support dual candidate generation
expected_effects: Higher recall across semantic and lexical slices
failure_modes: Uncalibrated score fusion suppresses a good lane
Added latency yields no answer-quality gain
